newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-May aluminium output up 15.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-May aluminium output up 15.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China produced 708,600 tonnes of aluminium in the first five months of this year, up 15.2 percent compared with a year ago, the China Securities said on Friday.
Aluminium output was 172,800 tonnes in May alone, the newspaper quoted the State Statistical Bureau as saying.
Production of aluminium products reached 465,200 tonnes in the first five months, up 10.3 percent year-on-year, it said. Output in May alone was 118,600 tonnes.
China's alumina output reached 1.2172 million tonnes in the first five months, down 21.4 percent year-on-year, it said.
China produced 261,400 tonnes of alumina in May alone, the newspaper said.
